title: WV Agriculture Ripley Warehouse Electrical Upgrade
overview: The state's food-distribution warehouse — with ~20,000 SF of cooler/freezer space serving WV K-12 schools — needed more capacity for expanded refrigeration. MEI increased the service from 1,200 to 3,000 amps, housed the new gear in a pre-fabricated building, split the distribution to reuse the existing generator, and added a second for a phased, outage-minimizing cutover.
